summary: The dyadic child map is injective and preserves the midpoint and good parity class; Brunn-Minkowski gives the required child reservoir-weight comparison. The two possible load deficits define genuine subcapacities hit by the fixed global affine maps, so each is bounded by the accepted capacity R. The threshold arithmetic, valuation decrease, endpoint metronoid inclusions, pair-body identity, and centroid-completion inclusion are all correct under the stated hypotheses.
